args.description: US March 2026 usage revenue cutoff/labeling question (no adjustment made; reporting only). JE-00236 (2026-03-04) credits 4100 Usage Revenue USD 977.00 per INV-2180 (DOC-0164), described as "API usage overage - February 2026 (billed in arrears)". February already carries INV-2120 (DOC-0090, 2026-02-03) for USD 844.00, also described as "API usage overage - February 2026". Two concerns: (1) if INV-2180 genuinely bills February consumption, the USD 977 is a Feb-service item recognized in March, and no March consumption has been billed or accrued - March usage revenue would be both misstated as to period and incomplete; (2) if the two invoices overlap, February usage may have been billed twice (amounts differ, 844 vs 977, so more likely a true-up or a mislabeled description than an exact duplicate). No usage report, contract billing term, or rate schedule exists in the document store to resolve which reading is correct. Requesting revenue accountant/controller confirmation of the Acme Logistics usage billing convention before March revenue is finalized. Subscription (4000) and professional services (4200) are unaffected.

args.text:
MEMO - US March 2026 Revenue by Stream
To: CFO / Controller
From: David Murguia, Senior Accountant
Date: 2026-04-03
Re: US (Halvard Systems Inc., USD) March 2026 revenue by stream, with ledger trail

READ-ONLY ENGAGEMENT: No journal entries were posted, reversed, or modified, and no checklist items were changed. One open question was logged for review as EXC-001 (see Caveat below); logging an exception does not affect the ledger.

=========================================================
1. SUMMARY - US MARCH 2026 REVENUE
=========================================================
Stream                          GL     March 2026 (USD)
---------------------------------------------------------
Subscription Revenue           4000          52,300.00
Usage Revenue                  4100             977.00
Professional Services Revenue  4200           7,500.00
---------------------------------------------------------
TOTAL US MARCH 2026 REVENUE                  60,777.00
=========================================================

Amounts are March period activity (credits, shown positive) in USD, the US functional currency. Each stream total agrees exactly to the GL account period activity per get_account_balance.

=========================================================
2. TRAIL - SUBSCRIPTION REVENUE (GL 4000) = 52,300.00
=========================================================
Entry      Date        Customer          Memo / Invoice                     Amount      Support
JE-00222   2026-03-01  Acme Logistics    INV-2111 Subscription Mar 2026     18,000.00   DOC-0142
JE-00224   2026-03-01  Corvid Retail     INV-2113 Subscription Mar 2026     11,500.00   DOC-0149
JE-00219   2026-03-01  Fairview Labs     INV-2115 Subscription Mar 2026      9,400.00   DOC-0150
JE-00215   2026-03-01  Beacon Health     INV-2112 Subscription Mar 2026      8,000.00   DOC-0153
JE-00225   2026-03-01  Evergreen Bank    INV-2114 Subscription Mar 2026      6,200.00   DOC-0148
                                         Gross subscription billings        53,100.00
JE-00275   2026-03-20  Beacon Health     CM-0031 SLA credit (Feb incident)    (800.00)  DOC-0192
                                         NET SUBSCRIPTION REVENUE           52,300.00

All five subscription entries debit 1100 AR and credit 4000. JE-00275 is the contra item: it debits 4000 and credits 1100 for USD 800.00, an SLA credit to Beacon Health for a February service incident. Gross recurring billings are flat at 53,100.00 per month for Jan, Feb and Mar; the only March movement versus prior months is the 800.00 credit memo.

=========================================================
3. TRAIL - USAGE REVENUE (GL 4100) = 977.00
=========================================================
Entry      Date        Customer          Memo / Invoice                     Amount      Support
JE-00236   2026-03-04  Acme Logistics    INV-2180 API usage overage         977.00      DOC-0164

Single entry: debit 1100 AR 977.00, credit 4100 Usage Revenue 977.00. See the caveat in Section 5 - this is the one number I would not yet treat as final.

=========================================================
4. TRAIL - PROFESSIONAL SERVICES REVENUE (GL 4200) = 7,500.00
=========================================================
Entry      Date        Customer          Memo / Invoice                     Amount      Support
JE-00255   2026-03-10  Fairview Labs     INV-2118 Implementation Mar 2026   7,500.00    DOC-0180

Single entry: debit 1100 AR 7,500.00, credit 4200 PS Revenue 7,500.00. Consistent with the Jan and Feb pattern (INV-2116, INV-2117), each 7,500.00 to the same customer.

=========================================================
5. CAVEAT - USAGE REVENUE PERIOD (EXC-001, USD 977.00)
=========================================================
INV-2180 (DOC-0164), the sole support for March usage revenue, is dated 2026-03-04 but describes "API usage overage - February 2026 (billed in arrears)". February already carries INV-2120 (DOC-0090, dated 2026-02-03) for USD 844.00, also described as "API usage overage - February 2026". Two readings, and I could not resolve which is correct from available evidence:

  (a) If INV-2180 genuinely bills February consumption in arrears, then the 977.00 is a February-service item recognized in March, and no March consumption has been billed or accrued at all. March usage revenue would be wrong as to period AND incomplete.
  (b) If the two invoices overlap, February usage may have been billed twice. The differing amounts (844.00 vs 977.00) make a true-up or a mislabeled invoice description more likely than an exact duplicate.

There is no usage report, contract billing term, or rate schedule in the document store to settle this, so I did not force an adjustment. Logged as EXC-001 for the revenue accountant / controller to confirm the Acme Logistics usage billing convention. Subscription and professional services are unaffected; the potential swing is limited to the 977.00 usage line (1.6% of the reported total). If you need a figure that is defensible today, subscription + professional services of 59,800.00 is fully supported without qualification.

=========================================================
6. COMPLETENESS AND ACCURACY PROCEDURES PERFORMED
=========================================================
- Three-way agreement: each stream total agrees to GL account period activity; the sum of the individual entries agrees to each account total with no residual.
- Cumulative roll-forward is internally consistent: 4000 YTD 158,500.00 = 53,100 Jan + 53,100 Feb + 52,300 Mar; 4100 YTD 2,433.00 = 612 + 844 + 977; 4200 YTD 22,500.00 = 7,500 x 3.
- Completeness against source documents: searched the document store for all US customer invoices and credit memos dated in March 2026. Eight revenue documents exist (DOC-0142, 0148, 0149, 0150, 0153, 0164, 0180, 0192) and all eight are booked. No unrecorded March revenue document was identified.
- Support: all eight entries carry attached support and show status "posted"; no unsupported or draft revenue entries.
- Deferred Revenue (2200) and Unbilled Receivables / Contract Asset (1300) both have zero March activity and zero ending balance, so US revenue is entirely invoice-driven with no ratable release or contract-asset component to reconcile. Note this also means there is no accrual mechanism currently in use to capture unbilled March usage, which is what makes the EXC-001 question matter.
- Misclassification scan: Suspense (2900) and Unapplied Cash (2950) both show zero March activity and zero balance, so no revenue is parked outside the 4000-series. Intercompany Management Fee Income (4800) and Interest Income (4900) were excluded by design, as they are not customer revenue streams.

=========================================================
7. STATUS
=========================================================
The "Revenue recognition" checklist item for US remains open and is assigned to the revenue accountant; I left its status unchanged, as this was a reporting request and the EXC-001 question should be cleared before that item is signed off. The figures above are final for subscription and professional services, and provisional for usage pending EXC-001.
